## Problem
Error messages in the Keelwater platform are misleading customers. When a user experiences a network failure on their own system, the error message presented implies the problem is a bug within the Keelwater software. This causes customers to waste time troubleshooting the wrong part of their system and erodes their trust in the platform's reliability.

## Who is affected
- The issue has been reported by a customer via the support channel [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].
- The affected customer is Marrowgate Commercial, which is a significant account with an Annual Recurring Revenue of £1,600,000 [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].

## Evidence
- A customer support interaction from Marrowgate Commercial explicitly states that the error message makes it sound like a bug [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].
- This issue has been mentioned 1 time in total [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].
- The single mention came through the support route [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].
- The data is based on 1 account [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].

## Why now
- The customer feedback was recorded on 2026-10-27 [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].
- The affected account, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].
- There has been 1 renewal event in the last 90 days [i:9b83bb79cb72d932].
- With a high-value account renewal imminent, addressing this trust issue is time-sensitive to prevent any impact on the renewal decision.
</previous_draft>
